elements.evidence: No super-cap; 21.3 lists indemnification as an Excluded Claim without a 3x cap

reasons: The inserted Section 20 completes every atomic element of the preferred position: Vendor defence and indemnity for Customer and Affiliates, all four triggers (IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), the notice/control/cooperation procedure, and Customer's indemnity confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

Fallback is incomplete (no customary exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund ladder, no 3x annual-fees super-cap), but that is irrelevant because the locked target level, preferred, is satisfied and the levels are separate bargains.

Minimality holds: the Agreement had no indemnity clause at all, and the insertion is a concise clause adding no hold-harmless language, no extra indemnitees, no Customer defence duty, and no settlement mechanics beyond notice/control/cooperation.

Intent preserved: uses only defined terms (Affiliates, Services, Deliverables, Applicable Law, Customer Data), leaves 19.4, 19.5 and 21.3 untouched and effective, and supplies the indemnity those sections already presuppose without creating contradiction or a dangling mechanic.
